If `create_model` builds a model over a proper subset of `n.snapshots`, `solve_model` still calls `extra_functionality` with `_to_model(n, n.snapshots)`, not the stored model snapshots. Under legacy semantics with `"auto"` or `"multiindex"`, `_to_model` leaves that full network index unchanged, so the callback receives snapshots beyond those the model was built over.
